# buildstock-corpus

> The AI-ready BuildStock corpus: the documentation of ComStock and of ResStock (technical
> reference, site pages, upgrade-measure reports) extracted to clean, release-tagged
> markdown, with a provenance manifest, a human-readable map, and a machine index. One
> dataset release per folder, under `processed/<product>/<release>/`. Two products:
> ComStock 2025 release 3 (`comstock_amy2018_2025_release_3`): 118 documents, 65 measures.
> ResStock 2025 release 1 (`resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1`): 62 documents, 32 measures.

Every file is served raw by GitHub, unauthenticated. The links below use `main`, the newest
build. To pin a citation, replace `main` with a release tag of the form
`<release id>-v<N>`; tags never move, and each product has its own. Current:

- ComStock: `comstock_amy2018_2025_release_3-v3`
- ResStock: `resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1-v1`

A product's files exist only at its own tags and on `main`: the ComStock tag does not
contain the ResStock folder. Do not mix facts across products or releases.

## Start here

Pick the product first; a question about housing is ResStock's, one about commercial
buildings is ComStock's. Two start orders, one per kind of reader: with a clone, read that
product's `CORPUS_MAP.md` first; fetching URLs without a clone, fetch that product's
`index.json` first, at its release tag. Then one section file.

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/AGENTS.md): how to read and cite the corpus, for agents

## ComStock (commercial buildings)

- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/comstock/comstock_amy2018_2025_release_3/index.json): every document and measure with its path, status, links, size and section files (fetch this first; ~155 KB raw, ~20 KB gzip-compressed over the wire)
- [sections.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/comstock/comstock_amy2018_2025_release_3/sections.json): every heading, H3 and below included, with its line range in the document (only when you need to land on a heading below H2; a range is the heading's own text down to the next heading of any level, not its sub-headings)
- [CORPUS_MAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/comstock/comstock_amy2018_2025_release_3/CORPUS_MAP.md): the same contents as a readable map, with the measure → upgrade-id → document table

## ResStock (housing)

- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/resstock/resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1/index.json): every document and measure with its path, status, links, size and section files (fetch this first; ~85 KB raw, ~11 KB gzip-compressed over the wire)
- [sections.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/resstock/resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1/sections.json): every heading, H3 and below included, with its line range in the document (only when you need to land on a heading below H2; a range is the heading's own text down to the next heading of any level, not its sub-headings)
- [CORPUS_MAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/processed/resstock/resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1/CORPUS_MAP.md): the same contents as a readable map, with the measure → upgrade-id → document table

## Documents

- Pattern: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/<ref>/processed/<product>/<release>/<corpus_path>`, where `corpus_path` comes from that product's index.json
- Line 1 of every document is a provenance header: product, release, upstream path, publication status, source and publication URLs, corpus version. It alone is enough to cite the file.
- Check `bytes` in index.json before fetching a whole document: 41 of ComStock's 118 documents and 14 of ResStock's 62 are over 100 KB. Every H2 is also its own file, named in the document's index.json row (`sections_dir` + `section_files`): fetch `<sections_dir>/<name>` instead of the document. Most section files are a few KB; a few are large (ComStock's Appendix A is one 450 KB section; in ResStock the Geometry and Envelope sections of guide chapter 3a are about 60 KB each, because each holds many housing characteristics under one H2). For a table inside a large section, take the line range of the innermost heading above the table from sections.json (the sub-heading the table sits under, not the heading above that, whose range stops at its first sub-heading).

## Optional

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/README.md): the authoring pipeline, layout, and smoke tests
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/main/CHANGELOG.md): one entry per tag; a product's newest tag is its topmost entry
- manifest.json, beside each index.json: sha256 of every input and output, clone commits, overlays, gaps
- crosswalk.json, beside each index.json: measure → upgrade id → document, with dates
- [schemas/](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/tree/main/schemas): JSON Schemas for index.json and sections.json
